title: Query Obfuscation with Embedding-Optimized Noise (EON): A Representational Blindspot in Agentic Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.31344v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In modern agentic and semantic retrieval systems, dense embedding models increasingly determine which intent, tool, document, memory, or image to retrieve for a query. We identify a representational failure mode in this pipeline: a meaningful query can be replaced by visibly nonsemantic content while preserving much of its retrieval outcome, even when the candidate bank is hidden from the optimizer. We introduce Embedding-Optimized Noise (EON), constructed using only the natural query representation, without access to candidate embeddings, relevance labels, rankings, retrieval feedback, or guardrail decisions. Despite this corpus-blind objective, EONs frequently preserve intent and tool routing, benchmark document search, episodic agent-memory retrieval, and cross-modal search across multiple dense embedding families. Crucially, this disconnect carries serious security implications: for malicious queries, an EON can reliably evade input

translated_title: 基于嵌入优化噪声（EON）的查询混淆：智能体检索中的表征盲区
translated_abstract: 在现代智能体与语义检索系统中，稠密嵌入模型日益决定着针对某个查询应检索何种意图、工具、文档、记忆或图像。我们在这一流程中发现了一种表征失效模式：一个有意义的查询可以被明显非语义的内容所替换，同时保留其大部分检索结果——即使候选库对优化器是隐藏的。我们提出了嵌入优化噪声（Embedding-Optimized Noise, EON），它仅使用自然查询自身的表示来构建，无需访问候选嵌入、相关性标签、排序、检索反馈或护栏决策。尽管这一目标对语料库是完全盲目的，EON 仍能在多个稠密嵌入模型家族中频繁地保留意图与工具路由、基准文档搜索、情景式智能体记忆检索以及跨模态搜索。至关重要的是，这种脱节带来了严重的安全隐患：对于恶意查询，EON 能够可靠地规避输入（安全过滤）。
tldr: 该论文发现，仅利用查询自身嵌入表示优化生成的非语义噪声（EON），在无法访问候选库、标签或反馈的情况下即可保留原查询的检索结果与工具路由，揭示了智能体检索系统可被恶意查询利用以规避安全过滤的表征盲区。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a representational blindspot in agentic retrieval: Embedding-Optimized Noise (EON), crafted solely from the query's own embedding without access to candidates, labels, or feedback, can preserve retrieval outcomes and tool routing—enabling malicious queries to reliably evade input filtering and posing serious security risks.
